text:
amy_sales: Prospect wants an air-gapped POC. Key asks: single-command rollback, upgrade cadence, and pricing for onsite + after-hours. Can we confirm what we can commit to for the SOW?

matt_eng: We can deliver a pinned POC bundle, signed artifacts, a CLI with `--compat-check` and `--rollback`, and signed delta patches for security fixes. Single-command rollback works if preflight/backup present.

nora_se: Telemetry is off by default; audit logs remain local. We'll supply GPG fingerprints, sha256 lists, and a short key rotation guide for the POC.

sid_account: Pricing: onsite validation day and after-hours emergency SLA are billable add-ons. I'll draft SOW line items.

ops_lead: POC guarantees: pinned build, security-only deltas, 4-hour remote rollback assist during agreed window, optional paid onsite dry-run. Upgrade cadence we recommend: security monthly, minor every 2-3 months, major ~6 months.

amy_sales: They asked about large weights transfer.

matt_eng: For >30GB models we suggest pre-seeded encrypted drives or signed manifest + physical transfer. Deltas for model metadata are possible but full weight swaps may need shipping.

deploy-bot: artifact-check redwood/poc-bundle/1765349999 passed signatures and staged for airgap preview. :white_check_mark:

ops_lead: Action items: matt to draft 1-page rollback playbook (ETA: EOD), nora to prepare advisory + key rotation guide (ETA: 2 days), sid to attach pricing lines (ETA: EOD).

amy_sales: I'll send to infosec + procurement and set a scoping call. Thanks team :pray:
